summary.learning_goal: Inspect a three-tiered hall and its stacked architectural components.
summary.primary_visualization: Circular hall on stepped terraces, with roofs and columns in exploded layers.
summary.primary_interaction: Demo changes viewpoint, separates vertical layers, and reassembles the hall.

strengths: The named hall and stacked circular roof/terrace form are presented consistently.
weaknesses: Exact dimensions and historical text have not been independently checked.

strengths: Vertical separation exposes a structural hierarchy otherwise hidden by the roofs.
weaknesses: Small text and unlabelled separated pieces limit explanation of what each layer does.

strengths: Layer spacing preserves the central axis during disassembly.
weaknesses: Decorative trees compete with the lower building in some camera views.

strengths: The demo shows distinct assembled, exploded and closer inspection states.
weaknesses: Physical setup and control responsiveness cannot be verified from the video.

strengths: A compact bottom control bar preserves most of the viewport for architecture.
weaknesses: Secondary labels have low contrast; mobile behavior is unknown.

principles_to_learn: Explode buildings along their construction axis.
Retain a recognizable assembled view as an anchor.
Label the purpose of each revealed layer beside the 3D object.
things_not_to_copy: Do not infer historic accuracy from procedural detail.
Do not let decorative landscaping obscure the structure being taught.
golden_recommendation: Provisional demo reference. Use for exploded view, camera inspection. Live behavior remains unverified.
